items.text: the arrows that go between panels are slim tabs beside the panel, off its content; touch one and the next panel's icon comes forward, let go to go there
beats are beats, not drums: a beat can be any sound
swipe sideways on a panel with tabs to turn its tabs (presets, sound, color); at the last tab it bounces
round arrows on either side of an open panel go to the next or previous one (presets, random, capture, sound) without going back to the bar; [ and ] do the same
the Pro mark is a lock with a lightning bolt in it
in every list the star is on the left and the handle you drag is on the right (looks and the random settings alike)
Scrub in Auto play's order, marked Pro: your touch will move through the looks as well as the field, in the order picked with it
the preset list has two tabs. Looks holds the list (show, sort, star, save); Auto play has a big play button and big tiles for how often, in what order and how it morphs
the Auto play tab always shows what the bar's play button is doing: on, off, the look playing and the time to the next one
hold ‹ or › to open Looks, hold ▶ to open Auto play
Save this look is a big button at the foot of the preset list, always in reach
the preset list shows all, starred or yours, and sorts by your own order, a–z, most picked or newest; star a look to keep it at the top
auto play can go through your starred looks only

when the phone takes the sound away (another app, a call, leaving the app) and does not give it back, the next tap brings it back: Current rebuilds its sound and starts again what was playing, instead of showing playing in silence until a restart
